past.heading: A mixed time
past.text: This time had ups and downs in about equal share. A neighbour or relative dropped in, and it was a warm visit. You bought something small for the home, and it was useful. Spending on the family went up a little for a festival. An elder gave advice, and you followed some of it. Some weeks were quiet and some were full. Overall, it was an even mix.

past.heading: A good time
past.text: These months were happy, with warm moments on many days. Relatives visited, and your home felt full of joy. Your neighbours joined you for a small function, and it went well. You spent on festival items and were happy with them. An elder gave you a good idea, and it worked. A small repair at home was done quickly. In all, these months left your family in good cheer.

future_free.heading: A mixed time
future_free.text: This is likely to be a balanced time, with easy days and busy days taking turns. A relative may visit and stay a few days. Neighbours may ask for your help with a function. Home expenses may be a little higher after the festival. An elder may share a thought that makes you think. A small repair may be started and take a while. Overall, it may be an even mix of rest and work.
